scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Rehabilitation of Sick Enterprise
other_conditions: Enterprise must have obtained acknowledgment or registration from the Ministry of MSME or the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
Enterprise must be a new manufacturing enterprise or an existing enterprise undertaking expansion or diversification.
Enterprise should have commenced commercial production during the operative period (October 5, 2022 to October 4, 2027).
Enterprise must be classified as a sick industrial enterprise as per RBI guidelines.
Diagnostic reports must be prepared by an expert or expert agency.
Application must be submitted during the scheme's operative period.
benefits_summary: Provides 50% reimbursement of the cost for preparing the Draft Rehabilitation Scheme and a financial assistance of ₹1,00,000.
